task.description:
Re-validate the reworked design artefact at src/design/sbx04-06-design.md and new spec templates/specs/sbx04-06-migration.yaml for SBX-04, SBX-05, SBX-06.

Verify that all three prior gaps are resolved:
- GAP-01: §3 no longer contains inline SQL DDL — only a reference to the migration spec
- GAP-02: templates/specs/sbx04-06-migration.yaml exists and contains the full migration spec
- GAP-03: §9 error taxonomy has a Path column distinguishing claim-path vs release-path error codes

Also re-verify full criteria:
1. All acceptance criteria in SBX-04, SBX-05, SBX-06 covered
2. No implementation code (interfaces/types/data-flow only)
3. Complete enough for BACKEND-DEV and TEST-DESIGNER to proceed
4. SBX-05 byte-identical sentinel explicitly addressed

Return PASS if all criteria met, FAIL with remaining gaps.

result.summary: Re-validation PASS. All three prior gaps resolved: GAP-01 (§3 contains no inline SQL DDL — references migration spec only), GAP-02 (templates/specs/sbx04-06-migration.yaml exists and is complete), GAP-03 (§9 error taxonomy has a Path column distinguishing CLAIM vs RELEASE paths). All acceptance criteria for SBX-04/05/06 are covered. SBX-05 byte-identical sentinel addressed in §6.2. Zig function signatures present in §10. Audit event types named in §4. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 on both artefacts. codegen_migration.py --dry-run exits 0 and preview covers all acceptance criteria. One MINOR: Y010 on migration YAML (filename does not match known Lego spec suffix) — no BLOCKER/MAJOR.

issues.check: Correctness — Type C YAML filename suffix
issues.description: lint_design_artefact.py Y010: templates/specs/sbx04-06-migration.yaml does not match a known Lego spec suffix and schema lint was skipped. The file is sbx04-06-migration.yaml; the linter expects a suffix like '*.migration.yaml' or '*.crud-endpoint.yaml'. This is a naming convention gap only; the file content is valid and codegen_migration.py --dry-run exits 0.
